messages.subject: non-compensatory within Item MIRT on polytomous items
parts:
Dear Phil,

I would like to conduct a non-compensatory within Item MIRT on polytomous items. I tried itemtype = 'PC2PL' but found it works for dichotomous items only.

May I know whether and how to run a non-compensatory within Item MIRT on polytomous (or a mixed of polytomous and dichotomous) items using “mirt"?

Thank you very much!

Jinxin

On Tue, Dec 17, 2019 at 8:11 PM Jinxin Zhu <jx...@s.eduhk.hk> wrote:
Dear Phil,

I would like to conduct a non-compensatory within Item MIRT on polytomous items. I tried itemtype = 'PC2PL' but found it works for dichotomous items only.

This has not been added to mirt yet, mostly because I only recently developed such extensions in a to-be-publicized article (draft is on research gate: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/336990068_Partially_and_Fully_Non-compensatory_Response_Models_for_Dichotomous_and_Polytomous_Items). As such, all partially non-compensatory models are limited to dichotomous response data for now. I'll add the ordered polytomous versions once the article moves into press. 

Phil

May I know whether and how to run a non-compensatory within Item MIRT on polytomous (or a mixed of polytomous and dichotomous) items using “mirt"?

Thank you very much!

Jinxin
